title: The Mass Psychology That Made a Town Lynch Its Own Mayor—Over a Park Bench
hook: A single rumor about a park bench turned an entire town against its leader in less than 48 hours.
why_this_can_go_viral: The trivial trigger for extreme violence makes viewers question their own susceptibility to groupthink.

why_this_can_go_viral: The life-or-death consequence of a tiny typo is terrifyingly relatable and shareable.

hook: Every passenger saw a man who wasn't there. They attacked empty seats, screaming at nothing.
